## Problem and result

What user-visible problem does this solve, and what happens after the change?

## Verification

List the checks actually run. Distinguish unit/HTTP fixtures, Electron checks, real models/providers and human visual/audio observations. Include a small shareable example or screenshot when useful.

## Limits and attribution

Note untested configurations or remaining issues. For media or adapted code, identify its source and applicable terms. Use redacted/synthetic examples and keep private data and credentials out of the change.
